_readme: Ready-to-use POST /api/plan request bodies. Date must stay within 2025-2030; time must be 05:00-24:00 Cairo time. Every entry maps to a route that actually exists in the 2018 TfC GTFS + frequencies.txt. NOTE: in this feed Metro Line 3 runs Attaba -> Al-Ahram (Heliopolis) only; the M3 extension to Adly Mansour opened after 2018 and is NOT in the data, so metro cannot reach Adly Mansour here.

routes.name: Abbassiya → Stadium (M3, no transfer)
routes.description: Short eastbound M3 hop — the baseline smoke test from the API docs.

routes.name: Attaba → Al-Ahram (M3, full eastern run)
routes.description: Full length of Metro Line 3 eastbound in this feed (Attaba → Al-Ahram, Heliopolis). Longest single-line M3 trip available.

routes.name: Helwan → New El-Marg (M1, end to end)
routes.description: Full length of Metro Line 1 from the southern terminus to the northern terminus.

routes.name: Sadat (Tahrir) → Helwan (M1 southbound)
routes.description: Long M1 southbound run from downtown to the Helwan terminus.

routes.name: Sadat (Tahrir) → New El-Marg (M1 northbound)
routes.description: Long M1 northbound run from downtown to the New El-Marg terminus.

routes.name: El-Maadi → Sadat (M1, southside to downtown)
routes.description: Commuter route from the Maadi residential area to Tahrir/downtown.

routes.name: Shubra El-Kheima → El-Mounib (M2, end to end)
routes.description: Full M2 from the northern terminus to the southern terminus.

routes.name: Shubra El-Kheima → El-Giza (M2, cross-city run)
routes.description: Full length of Metro Line 2 — crosses downtown via the Sadat interchange.

routes.name: Helwan → El-Mounib (M1 + M2, 1 transfer)
routes.description: Requires an M1→M2 transfer (Sadat/Nasser). Tests multi-leg metro routing across two lines.

routes.name: El-Mounib → Al-Ahram (M2 + M3, transfer at Attaba)
routes.description: M2 northbound to Attaba, then M3 eastbound to Al-Ahram. Tests the M2/M3 interchange.

routes.name: New El-Marg → Al-Ahram (M1 + M3, multi-transfer)
routes.description: M1 to a downtown interchange, M2 link, then M3 to Al-Ahram. Tests deeper multi-transfer metro routing.

routes.name: Abbassiya → Sadat (bus only)
routes.description: Forces bus routing only — generic check that bus lines are loaded from frequencies.txt.

routes.name: Dawaran Shubra → Al Shorouq (Bus 1016)
routes.description: Real bus line 1016 (Dawaran Shubra-Al Shorouq), the eastbound line seen suggested for Attaba → Adly Mansour.

routes.name: 1st Settlement → Abd Al Moneim Riad (Bus 1001)
routes.description: Real bus line 1001 (First Settlement-Abd Al Moneim Riad), New Cairo to downtown.

routes.name: 1st Settlement → Attaba (Bus 1010)
routes.description: Real bus line 1010 (First Settlement-Attaba), New Cairo to the Attaba hub.

routes.name: Al Shorouq → Helwan (bus + metro)
routes.description: Bus-only eastern origin to the far southern metro terminus: optimal path is bus west to a metro railhead, then M1 south. Should combine BUS + SUBWAY.

routes.name: 1st Settlement → El-Mounib (bus + metro)
routes.description: New Cairo (no metro) to the M2 southern terminus: optimal path is bus to a metro station, then M2. Should combine BUS + SUBWAY.

routes.name: Attaba → El-Maadi (all transit modes)
routes.description: Lets OTP pick the best combination of bus and metro. Tests that multi-mode queries deduplicate correctly.
